records.subject: Still want to get River Dynamics set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Wanted to check if timing was the issue -- if now's better than when you signed up, happy to do a quick setup call.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, River Dynamics!
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, created a first project on day 1 ([email:bace9a92] welcome, no reply), but no key milestone and no invite since. No tickets, no inbound signal of engagement — silence after an early burst usually means drift, though 8 days remain and the first project shows some intent.

draft.subject: Quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

You got your first project set up in Wrenfield last week — nice start. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the next thing worth filling in.

If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to look at how you want River Dynamics' work organized and point you at the right next step.

Best,
Priya
